verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents only narrow, purpose-specific background automation: it automatically generates embeddings for every document once an embedder is configured, and separate sync tools (Meilisync, the Rails ActiveRecord integration, Firebase sync) keep data synced automatically. Nothing shows a general facility for users or agents to define autonomous automations; the MCP server is interactive and prompt-driven, not background. Missing for 10: user-definable automations or workflows, scheduling or triggers, webhooks or event-driven actions, agent-run background tasks, and independent corroboration.
